actions.action: Read the Ohio Tropicals Monstera problems article
Make sure the plant gets plenty of light
Check how the soil feels before watering
Let the soil dry out (to the bottom) between waterings and water less
Buy a moisture meter and water when it reads about 3 at the pot bottom
Occasionally flush the soil with water to remove excess salts
Improve air circulation by trimming or tying back stems
Check out planterina on Instagram/YouTube for Monstera care

verdict.reason: The thread dump names overwatering/root rot as the likely cause but mixes it with underwatering, fungus and other possibilities and never mentions the oversized pot, so the watering-reduction part of the fix is buried and the repotting is missing; nothing is likely harmful.
